Really disappointing experience
Mar 2026 • Couples
I ordered the crispy pork with kale and egg fried rice. The dish arrived on its own and was already cold. 
There was barely any pork in it – mostly vegetables – and the few pieces that were there were just soggy long white fatty strings rather than crispy pork.

We then had to wait ages for my partner’s dish and the rest of the meal. No one checked on our table, even though most of the food was left uneaten. 
While other tables around us seemed to receive hot meals quickly, our dishes arrived cold and incomplete, which made the experience even more disappointing.

Unfortunately this was one of the worst Thai meals I’ve had. 
Very disappointing.
